extracted.name: Crangria
extracted.description: Try our non-alcoholic twist on sangria at Christmas time, with cranberry and pineapple juice and plenty of fruit. Garnish with mint to serve
instruction_lines: Pour the cranberry and pineapple juice into a large pitcher along with a large handful of ice.
Tip in the remaining ingredients and stir well before pouring into glasses to serve.
